speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing chest pain and shortness of breath; to help me understand the severity, can you describe exactly where the pain is located and what triggers it? Also, have you noticed any sweating, nausea, or pain radiating to your arm or jaw?

text: The pain feels like a tight band right in the center of my chest and it shoots down into my left arm and jaw. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Coronary Syndrome (likely Unstable Angina or NSTEMI). Given the classic presentation of exertional chest pain radiating to the jaw and arm with diaphoresis, this is a medical emergency requiring immediate cardiac monitoring and ECG.
